purpose: Seal TIM-004 as reuse of the admitted SYS-006 allowlisted automation control plane without inventing a Time business job, handler, API, event, receipt, route, menu or schema and without issuing a packet, token, worktree, migration lease or source authority.

targetFamilyRegister.interpretation: The five-row family proves consolidation to the four related SYS contracts, not five Time jobs or any exact executable Time handler.

sourceSemanticsDecision.businessMeaning: Time-related scheduling may use the central allowlisted automation definition, run, attempt, retry and receipt contracts, but TIM-004 itself owns no executable business job.

sys002Owns: central primary page ownership and completion accounting
sys006Owns: automation logical definition and immutable versions
run, run attempt, item, item attempt and checkpoint state
lease, fence, concurrency, idempotency and cancellation coordination
failed-item retry, dead-letter and compensation coordination
control-plane command receipts, audit and outbox evidence
signed handler registry and typed runtime dispatch ports
ownershipDecision.timeBusinessScheduleDistinction: Time work-regime or roster schedules are domain business facts and are not SYS-006 automation schedules.
ownershipDecision.crossServiceRule: No service may query or mutate another service database; any future Time execution bridge requires a separately sealed typed service or event contract.
ownershipDecision.completionRule: Central reuse does not transfer SYS-002 or SYS-006 ownership and produces no TIM-004 business-completion credit.

relatedReuseOnlyContracts.meaning: list or create central automation definition identity and metadata
read central run, attempt, item, checkpoint and receipt evidence
create a new retry attempt for the immutable eligible failed-item set

typedArtifactDecision.interpretation: Their availability proves a generic closed central protocol only; it does not prove a TIM-004 provider, handler, business input or result.

mustSealBeforePacket: one source-authoritative Time business command and aggregate boundary
the exact ownerService dwp-time-server, handlerKey and handlerContractVersion triple
a signed ACTIVE PDX-004 manifest, trusted key revision and exact allowed scopes
closed input and result schema refs and lowercase SHA-256 digests with unknown fields rejected
trusted tenant, purpose, scope and authorized population derivation
deterministic immutable item identity, order and expected cardinality
domain effect idempotency key and request-digest derivation
retry mode, maximum attempts and retryable versus final error mapping
RESULT_UNKNOWN reconciliation and lost-lease or stale-fence behavior
declared compensation policy or an explicit no-compensation decision
resultRef, resultDigest, errorCode and Time-owned event mapping
one explicitly authorized cross-service execution topology
futureHandlerSuccessorRequirements.sharedChangeRule: Any Platform, gateway, Auth or shared contract delta requires a separate central successor and cannot be hidden in a TIM owner token.
futureHandlerSuccessorRequirements.schemaRule: A Time-owned durable business-result gap must be proven before requesting any TIME_MAIN migration lease.

migrationDecision.timePersistenceRule: Existing Time domain persistence remains owned by its respective admitted slices and is neither altered nor re-counted by TIM-004.
migrationDecision.futureEscalation: Stop and author an append-only semantic successor naming the exact missing Time-owned table or column, then obtain a separate exclusive V15 lease.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: TIM-004 remains a NON_UI_SUPPORTING_SLICE and adds no Time route, menu, page, action descriptor or frontend request.
IAQ-059 and /hr/settings/operations remain owned by SYS-002, SYS-006 remains the automation technical owner, and neither ownership nor completion credit transfers to TIM-004.
SYS-API-017 through SYS-API-020 remain related reuse-only Platform contracts and no primary TIM API, command, event or receipt is introduced.
No Time scheduler, automation controller, registry provider, control-plane aggregate, run worker, retry worker, DLQ manager or cross-service database access is created.
Arbitrary class, method, SQL, script or callback dispatch and any browser-asserted tenant, purpose or owner authority are rejected.

No Time handler is registered or called unless a later separately admitted successor seals the exact ownerService, handlerKey and handlerContractVersion triple, signed ACTIVE manifest, closed schemas, scopes and execution topology.
No Time payload, population selector, domain command, result or compensation contract is inferred from the five source rows or from generic PDX-004, PDX-005 and PDX-006 availability.
SYS-006 and the shared Platform stores remain the only truth for automation definitions, runs, attempts, item receipts, retry, dead-letter and SYS-EVT-004; Time creates no parallel ledger or event.
TIME_MAIN remains at V14, V15 is neither reserved nor authored, and any future V15 request requires a separately proven Time-owned durable business-result delta and exclusive lease.
The central automation feature remains default OFF with zero TIM tenants, schedules, providers, handler bindings and Time handler calls.

TIM_CLOSE_PERIOD_DEFINITION_PRODUCER and TIM_CLOSE_TRUSTED_OWNER_HEADER_ISSUER remain open unchanged and continue to block enrollment, activation, completion credit and live Time-to-Payroll claims as declared.
This reuse-only closure grants zero business-completion increment and no packet, token, worktree, migration lease, central source or module source authority.

targetedGoldenScenarios.scenario: The settings operations surface remains under SYS-002 and exposes no TIM-004 route, menu, page or action.
With the central feature OFF and no enrolled tenant, zero call reaches any Time service.
An unknown or arbitrary handler identity is rejected before dispatch and creates no domain effect.
A missing schema digest, unsigned, inactive, revoked or identity-mismatched manifest is rejected without Time invocation.
The same Platform idempotency key and digest replays the original receipt while a different digest conflicts, and no Time receipt ledger exists.
Retry creates a new immutable Platform attempt for eligible failed items and never rewrites an earlier PDX-006 receipt.
RESULT_UNKNOWN remains subject to trusted reconciliation and is never converted to success by inference or blind redispatch.
Unavailable current handler authority or a lost lease or stale fence blocks effect execution.
A proposed Time schema change without an exact Time-owned durable business-result delta receives no V15 lease.
Zero production registry, provider, scheduler and handler binding results in zero Time effect.
Either carried P0 gate remaining open blocks tenant enrollment, activation and live Time-to-Payroll claims.
Any attempted TIM UI, event, automation table, private receipt, retry ledger or DLQ is rejected as an ownership breach.

targetedVerificationPlan.policy: Validate only the changed disposition and its pinned evidence; expand only if a targeted failure proves broader impact.

nonClaims: An executable Time automation job, handler, adapter, input, result, population or compensation contract exists.
The five source rows identify five Time jobs or authorize any inferred Time behavior.
PDX-004, PDX-005 or PDX-006 proves a TIM-004 provider or production binding.
A TIM API, event, receipt, route, menu, page, action descriptor, scheduler, worker or ledger was created.
TIME_MAIN V15 was reserved, authored or required.
A packet, token, worktree, lease, central source or module source authority was issued.
IAQ-059 or the settings operations route transferred from SYS-002 to TIM.
SYS-006 control-plane ownership or completion was counted again.
Either TIM P0 gate was closed or reinterpreted.
A feature or tenant was enabled or enrolled, or a provider, schedule, handler, broker or customer datum was bound.
BASE-TFR-TIM-004 is a completed business slice, or Batch-05, R7 or HRIS is complete.
